items.title: [ECG] Invitation: HKU Faculty of Social Sciences International Admissions Talk (Sep 19) & 2027 Entry
items.author: Lee Meng Choo
items.description:
Message posted on behalf of HKU
Warm greetings from the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Hong Kong (HKU)-QS11!
We are delighted to invite your students and parents to our upcoming
International Admissions Talk
via Zoom, tailored for prospective students aiming for September 2027 admission.
As a world-leading institution situated in the heart of Asia's most dynamic global city, our faculty offers an internationally diverse learning community with rich opportunities for global exchanges, cross-disciplinary majors, credit-bearing internships, and comprehensive career support to launch high-impact global careers.
Event Details:
·
Date:
Saturday, 19 September 2026
·
Time:
15:00 PM – 16:00 PM (HKT) / 11:00 AM – 12:00 noon (GST)
·
Format:
Online via Zoom
·
Language:
English
·
Registration:
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/ahBxCv2f5c
·
Target:
Students, Parents, Career Counsellors
Our
Undergraduate Programmes
(Admissions open on September 23, 2026):
1.
Bachelor of Psychology (BPsych)
2.
Bachelor of Social Sciences (BSocSc)*
(Students in this flagship programme can choose a major from the following disciplines)
:
Computational Social Science
Geography
Politics and Public Administration
(Specializations available: International Relations, Public Policy)
Social Policy and Social Development
Sociology
(Note: Students pursuing the Bachelor of Social Sciences also have the unique flexibility to opt for a
second major
—either within the Social Sciences (such as Psychology) or across other faculties such as Business, Engineering, Science, or Arts).
3.
Bachelor of Social Work (BSW)
4.
Bachelor of Social Sciences (Government and Laws) and Bachelor of Laws
5.
Bachelor of Arts in Global Creative Industries (BA(GCIN)
6.
Bachelor of Journalism, Media and Artificial Intelligence (BJMAI)
